Task 27 XDD Maximum Distance Double Drop (Rule 15.18) Task order in any order - split
a. Description of scoring area(s) SA for loggermarks is SA inside of the square area with
the corners on the coordinates:
3050/0100, 3050/0000, 2880/0100, 2880/0000
and MMA for physical mark is the circles with R50m and
center points on coordinates 3114/0121 and 2827/0008.
You are allowed to drop:
2 x loggermarks inside square SA
or
1 x loggermark inside square area + physical marker
drop inside of one MMA
or
2 x Physical markers drops in MMAs
ATTENTION!
2 x loggermark + physical marker drop or 2 x physical
markers and loggermark in SA – no result!
The result :
1. Distance between 2 x loggermark,
or
2. Distance between loggermark and goal, minus [–]
result of physical marker drop.
3. Distance between two goals minus [-] results of
physical markers drops.
MMA R50m
Marker color red, white
Marker drop free
Scoring period ends at 09:45
Scoring area see description Loggermarker 3, 4
